Bldgs. 13 & 14 PARTY WALL DECLARATION OF RESTRICTIONS, made as of this 15th day of July, 2002,by Landmark Projects IV, Inc., having offices at 250 Park Avenue South, New York, NY Development Fund Company, Inc., having offices at One Battery Park Plaza, New York, New York 10004, (hereinafter referred to as the “NYCP") (Developer and NYCP are hereinafter collectively referred to as the“Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, NYCP is the owner of the real property in borough of Manhattan as described on Schedule“A'Block 1928Lot 46 andBlock 1928Lot 45,New York,NY, annexed hereto and made a part hereof, upon which Developer intends to build two new threefamily-four story townhouses; WHEREAS, the Developer has built two residential buildings in such a manner that eachof thebuildings shall adjoin the other and shall be connectedtoeach otherby a common Party Wall ("Party Wall"); WHEREAS theDeclarants desire to declare thefollowingrestrictions,covenants and agreements governing said Party Wall; and WHEREAS,thehomedesignatedasBlock1928·Lot46islocatedatstreet address 228 West 123 Street, New York, N.Y. and the home on the other side of the PartyWallis designatedasBlock1928Lot 45 and islocated atstreet address226West 123rdStreet,NewYork,NY; NOW THEREFORE, the following declaration of restrictions, covenants and agreements shall run with the land and be binding upon the Declarants herein, their heirs, successors and assigns and shall run with the land and be binding upon each successive owner of Block 1928 Lot 46 and of Block 1928 Lot 45, New York, N.Y. and the heirs, successorsand assigns ofeachsuch subsequentowner. 1. ThePartyWall was constructed in suchafashion as tobelocated an equal distance on or over the respective adjoining lots with the midline of the Party Wall being located as nearly as possible on the common boundary line and it is understood that minor variations may be present due to topographical problems or construction requirements. 2. ThePartyWall shall be used and maintained as a PartyWall forever and the owner of the lot on each side of the Party Wall, shall be licensed and permitted to enter upon the premises of the owner on the other side of the Party Wall to make intentions to do so. Furthermore, a representative of the owner of the premises to be entered must bepresentwhenever the owner orrepresentatives of the owner on

Bldgs.13&14 the other side of the Party Wall enters such premises, pursuant to this Declaration of Restrictions. 3. On the owner's side, said owner may at any time add to the Party Wall in depth or thickness, but any other addition to said Party Wall in length, height or otherwise must be consented toby the owners on both sides of thePartyWall.In no event shall any extension of the Party Wall, interfere with, or impair the use of the Party Wall, nor shall any such addition interfere with, or impair the use of the Party Wall by the other owner, nor shall any such extension of thePartyWall interferewith the use or enjoyment of the townhousebelonging to the adjoining owner. 4. If the Party Wall is at any time extended, the cost of such extension shall be paid by the owner making such extension. 5. IntheeventthePartyWallshallbedamagedordestroyedbyfireor othercasualty, the owners on each side of the Party Wall agree to reconstruct the Party Wall as provided herein with respect to use, location and construction; each owner agrees to apply the funds received from any insurance carrier, or third party who may be responsible for the damage to the Party Wall, toward the reconstruction of the Party Wall. 6. addition or change thereto, the owner so doing shall make such repairs or rebuild or addtoorextendsaidPartyWallinsuchawayastoleavetheownerontheother side of thePartyWall as nearly as is reasonably possible under the circumstances, in the same condition with respect to said Party Wall as before and shall use good material throughout and do such work in a good, substantial and workmanlike manner. Such owner so repairing or rebuilding or extending shall do all work in connection therewith, as far as is reasonably possible from his own side of the division line and shall do all work in conformance with the requirements of the Building Laws of the State and City of New York and the rules, regulations and ordinances of any governmental authority having jurisdiction thereof. 7. Party Wall as constructed, the cost of such repairing and/or such rebuilding, as to such portions of the Party Wall used by both owners, shall be borne equally by both owners. 8.  If and when the Party Wall is rebuilt it shall stand upon the same place and be of the same or similar materials and of the same proportions as the Party Wall described above. No director, member, officer or employee of the Declarants shall be personally liable under or by reason of this Declaration of Restrictions,nor shall any director, member, officer or employee be sued individually for damages by reason of a breachofthisDeclarationofRestrictions.

Bldgs. 13& 14 10.Nothing herein contained shall obligate or make responsible or liable in any way in connection with such Party Wall any owner of either of said parcels of land except for the owner's acts of omission and commissionwhile owner. 11. ThisDeclarationofRestrictions shall remainineffectsolong as one of the townhousesshallremainstanding.Intheeventbothtownhousesaredemolished or destroyed, then, and in such event, this Declaration of Restrictions shall automatically terminate,butnothing contained in thisDeclaration of Restrictions shall prevent the owners from negotiating and entering into a Party Wall Declaration of Restrictions.
